source: Locally extracted /Users/dido/Downloads/fp-handover-20261011; the zip itself is absent.

stop_fix.decision: Experimental candidate; no new camera evidence.

dma_claim.decision: Reject the interpretation of the +0x40000000 result as the controller DMA address.
dma_claim.actual_command: C01E6B80 loads context+0x38 and passes it to C01E6A48; C01E6AAA writes it directly to DEPCMDPAR1 at 0x2100C804 + physical_endpoint*0x10.
dma_claim.actual_bulk_payload: C01E5880 keeps 0x50000000 as the CPU uncached pointer, then C01E591E subtracts 0x40000000 and C01E5922 writes 0x10000000 to TRB bufptr.
dma_claim.cached_bulk_payload: For CPU pointers >=0xC0000000, the native path performs cache maintenance and conversion to the uncached CPU alias, then subtracts 0x40000000; C31E32C0 becomes 031E32C0 in bufptr.
dma_claim.scope: Software values in the native USB path are proved; whether an additional alternative DMA address is hardware-accessible is not tested. The submission does not establish identity-mapped RAW DMA.
dma_claim.worker_impact: Do not replace the current worker TO_BUS subtraction with identity from this handover.

limits: substituted endpoint selection, locks, caches and command acceptance
no DMA reachability, frame ownership, USB completion or image alignment proof

proposed_probe_corrections: Writing a shared TRB and starting a transfer changes endpoint state; it is not a read-only or no-risk observation.
The referenced RAW_PUSH note uses historical EP84/ctx4/physical9; current endpoints and ownership must be checked from maintained source.
Comparing a fixed 4 KiB RAW slice with CinemaDNG requires matching frame, packing, OB/stride and layout; mismatch is not proof of a different alias.
